usage: The word 狼 (long4) is a noun that refers to a wild animal known as a wolf.
It is used to talk about wolves in stories, nature, or when describing animal characteristics.
In Cantonese, 狼 is often used to represent cunning or fierceness, sometimes metaphorically for people.
狼 (long4) can be a subject or object in a sentence depending on the context.
The word is not usually combined with classifiers but can appear with the general classifier 隻 (zek3) when counting.
